question: Can a validated portable three-stock recovery bundle be bound to caller-selected local paths and published as one strict private recipe without rendering or weakening its semantic identity?
stop_rules: Do not modify historical strict recipes or recovery bundles.
Do not infer, search for or default either caller path.
Do not render, decode pixels, create the output target or contact a network.
Do not publish a recipe unless the selected input bytes match the bundle-bound input SHA-256.
Do not overwrite any existing recipe or output entry.
A passing binder creates a private strict recipe only; a later renderer must independently revalidate it.
claim_ceiling: Private explicit path binding and strict recipe publication only; no render authorization, installer, automatic rerender, export, calibrated stock response, stock distinguishability or release claim.
